rejected_attempt.decision: rejected because quantization destroyed model behaviour

desktop_integration: the build downloads both pinned files and verifies byte count plus SHA-256
the files are packaged as local Electron resources
the Python sidecar loads ONNX Runtime and the tokenizer lazily on the first evidence batch
the model receives only exact quote plus atomic claim, never the owner's question
a missing model remains an explicit unavailable signal
privacy: Only existing public synthetic English pairs were used. No local conversations or owner questions entered validation.
decision: Accept FP16 ONNX for the next Mac build. Reject INT8. Keep DeBERTa as a cautious signal, never the sole judge.
claim_boundary: This proves equivalence on thirty frozen short reference pairs on yukabox CPU. It does not yet prove the packaged Mac binary loads or that DeBERTa judges real retrieved evidence correctly.
